title: The normalized coefficient restriction isomorphism on total tensor complexes
statement: Let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism, let R and S be commutative ring sheaves on their small pro-etale sites, put A=f^{-1}R, and let c:A≅S [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Write U=Res_c and Tot_S,Tot_A for the signed direct-sum total tensor on cochain complexes [def-sfb-proetale-tensor-model]. For normalized RingIsoTensorTransport data o for c [lem-sfb-ring-isomorphism-tensor-transport], define sigma:Tot_S U_Ch≅(U_Ch×U_Ch)Tot_A by NatIso.ofComponents, with component at (P,Q) equal to o.totalIso(P,Q), and naturality given by o.total_naturality. This is the existing tensorIso definition, moved verbatim to a supporting module. Its summand API expresses the supplied normalization in the actual Tot functors: U(iota_{a,b});sigma^n=delta_{P^a,Q^b};iota_{a,b}, for a+b=n, where delta is the normalized ordinary tensor map of o.
